item.description:
Blinky 1.5.4

  • Settings lists every provider under Providers. Open Settings and choose Providers; search still finds an account by its name or the name you gave it. #60
  • The Blinky menu checks for updates. Check for Updates… is under About and opens the same update window as the button in Settings → About. #60
  • Manage extensions, Developer integrations and About share one section. They sit under Other at the bottom of the Settings sidebar. #60
  • Open at login is the first row under General. The switch registers the copy that is running, including Blinky.app after a rename from Pulse.app, and simplified Chinese labels the row 开机启动. #60
  • Sparkle's update window comes forward. A check that finds a newer version, on the schedule or from Check for Updates…, brings that window to the front and asks before installing. #60
  • The update window shows only the version being offered. Its notes are that version's changelog entry, and earlier releases are not stacked in the same window. #60
